jurisdiction_name: GROVE CITY COUNCIL WARD 3 (GROVE CITY-CITY City)
narrative: Grove City Council Ward 3 (City of Grove City-city) has 6,288 registered voters, with 51.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 29.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 19.1%, a clear Republican lean of 9.9 percentage points.
